unitTitle: Adjectives/Adverbs - Linking Words - Prepositions of Movement

exercises.instructionEn: Adjectives describe nouns. They are the same in the singular and the plural.
exercises.instructionUz: Sifat otni aniqlaydi. Sifat birlikda ham, ko'plikda ham bir xil bo'ladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

  Sifat OTNI aniqlaydi.
  Sifat BIRLIKDA ham, KO'PLIKDA ham BIR XIL bo'ladi.

  Look at this TALL tree.    (birlik — bitta daraxt)
  Look at these TALL trees.  (ko'plik — bir necha daraxt)


ENG MUHIM QOIDA — SIFAT HECH QAChON -S OLMAYDI:

  tall trees      ✓
  talls trees     ✗ XATO

  beautiful flowers   ✓
  beautifuls flowers  ✗ XATO

  Bu — o'zbek tilidan farq qiladigan muhim nuqta.
  Ingliz tilida OT ko'plik bo'ladi, SIFAT esa O'ZGARMAYDI.


DIQQAT — 'THIS' va 'THESE' O'ZGARADI:
  THIS tall tree    (birlik)
  THESE tall trees  (ko'plik)

  Ko'rsatish olmoshi OT bilan birga o'zgaradi,
  lekin SIFAT o'zgarmaydi.

  To'liq jadval:
     this  → these   (yaqin)
     that  → those   (uzoq)


SIFAT GAPDA QAYERDA TURADI:

  1) OTDAN OLDIN:
        a TALL tree;  a BEAUTIFUL day;  SCARY animals

  2) 'TO BE' dan KEYIN:
        The tree is TALL.
        The animals were SCARY.

  3) 'FEEL', 'LOOK', 'SEEM' dan KEYIN:
        He felt FRIGHTENED.
        They look FRIENDLY.


BIR NEChTA SIFAT BIRGA KELSA:
  Coursebook 77-betdagi hikoyada:
     'One GORGEOUS, SUNNY day' — ikki sifat, vergul bilan.
     'a little old cottage' — ikki sifat, vergulsiz.

  Odatdagi tartib:
     baho → o'lcham → yosh → rang → material
     a nice   little   old    white   silk   dress

points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 1-QOIDA.
'What kind of ...?' savoliga javob beradi.

points.en: They are the same in the singular and the plural.
points.uz: Sifat birlikda ham, ko'plikda ham bir xil bo'ladi.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 2-QOIDA — ENG MUHIM.
Sifat HECH QAChON -S olmaydi.
'talls trees' XATO.

BIRLIK: this + sifat + ot.
'a tree' — bitta daraxt.

KO'PLIK: these + sifat + otlar.
DIQQAT: 'this' → 'these' O'ZGARDI,
lekin 'tall' O'ZGARMADI.

exercises.instructionEn: Adverbs usually describe verbs. Form of adverbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Ravish odatda fe'lni aniqlaydi. Ravishning yasalishi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

  Ravish odatda FE'LNI aniqlaydi.
     He drives CAREFULLY.
     (How does he drive? CAREFULLY.)
     = U qanday haydaydi? Ehtiyotkorlik bilan.


FORM — UChTA QOIDA:

  1) Ravishni odatda sifatga -LY qo'shib yasaymiz.
        careful → carefully

  2) Sifat UNDOSH + Y bilan tugasa, -Y ni tushirib,
     -ILY qo'shamiz.
        lucky → luckily

  3) Ba'zi ravishlar SIFAT bilan BIR XIL shaklda bo'ladi.
        hard  → hard
        fast  → fast
        early → early

     ESLATMA:  good → WELL


SIFAT va RAVISHNI QANDAY AJRATISH:

  Savol bering:
     'WHAT KIND OF ...?' (qanday?)     → SIFAT
     'HOW ...?' (qanday qilib?)        → RAVISH

  Misol:
     He is a CAREFUL driver.  (qanday haydovchi? → SIFAT)
     He drives CAREFULLY.     (qanday haydaydi? → RAVISH)


GAPDA JOYI:
  SIFAT  — otdan OLDIN yoki 'to be' dan KEYIN
  RAVISH — fe'ldan KEYIN (yoki ba'zan oldin)


DIQQAT — -LY BILAN TUGAGAN SIFATLAR:
  friendly, lovely, silly, lonely, ugly — bular SIFAT!
  Ular RAVISH EMAS.
     He smiled in a FRIENDLY way.  ✓
     He smiled FRIENDLY.           ✗ XATO


DIQQAT — 'HARD' va 'HARDLY':
  hard   = qattiq, ko'p   (He works HARD.)
  hardly = deyarli emas   (He HARDLY works.)
  Ma'nosi BUTUNLAY TESKARI!

  Shunga o'xshash:
     late   = kech           ↔  lately = so'nggi paytda
     near   = yaqin          ↔  nearly = deyarli

points.en: Adverbs usually describe verbs. He drives carefully. (How does he drive? Carefully.)
points.uz: Ravish odatda fe'lni aniqlaydi. U ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydaydi.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA.
'How ...?' savoliga javob beradi.
'usually' — chunki ravish sifatni ham aniqlashi mumkin
('VERY careful').

points.en: We usually form adverbs by adding -ly to the adjective. careful - carefully
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 1-QOIDA.
loud → loudly;  quick → quickly;  slow → slowly.

points.en: When the adjective ends in a consonant + y, we drop -y and add -ily. lucky - luckily
points.uz: Sifat undosh + y bilan tugasa, -y ni tushirib -ily qo'shamiz.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 2-QOIDA.
happy → happily;  easy → easily;  angry → angrily.
DIQQAT: FAQAT undosh + y uchun.

points.en: Some adverbs have the same form as their adjectives. hard → hard, fast → fast, early → early
points.uz: Ba'zi ravishlar sifat bilan bir xil shaklda bo'ladi.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI 3-QOIDA.
'fastly' va 'hardly' (bu ma'noda) shakllari YO'Q.
'hardly' BOR, lekin ma'nosi 'deyarli emas'.

ISTISNO.
'goodly' shakli YO'Q.
'He speaks English WELL.' ✓
'He speaks English GOOD.' ✗ XATO

sections.title: Linking Words: and, because, but, so, then, when
sections.titleUz: Bog'lovchilar: and, because, but, so, then, when

exercises.instructionEn: We use linking words to join sentences.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:
  Gaplarni BIRLAShTIRISh uchun bog'lovchilardan
  foydalanamiz.

OLTI MISOL — HAR BIRI IKKI SHAKLDA BERILGAN:

  AND — qo'shimcha, ketma-ketlik
     He locked the door. He left the house.
     → He locked the door AND left the house.
     DIQQAT: ikkinchi 'he' TUShIB QOLDI.

  BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIK
     Tom wanted to watch TV. I didn't.
     → Tom wanted to watch TV, BUT I didn't.

  BECAUSE — SABAB
     Julie was happy. She didn't have any homework.
     → Julie was happy BECAUSE she didn't have any homework.

  SO — NATIJA
     I was very tired. I decided to go to bed.
     → I was very tired, SO I decided to go to bed.

  THEN — KETMA-KETLIK
     She parked the car. She went inside.
     → She parked the car, THEN she went inside.

  WHEN — VAQT
     He was at work. He heard the news.
     → He was at work WHEN he heard the news.


QAY BIRINI TANLASH — SAVOL BERING:

  Ikkinchi gap SABABNI aytadimi?         → BECAUSE
  Ikkinchi gap birinchisining NATIJASImi? → SO
  Ikkinchi gap QARAMA-QARShImi?          → BUT
  Ikkinchi gap QAChON bo'lganini aytadimi? → WHEN
  Ketma-ket sodir bo'ldimi?               → AND yoki THEN


BECAUSE va SO — TARTIBI TESKARI:

     NATIJA + BECAUSE + SABAB
        I went to bed BECAUSE I was tired.

     SABAB + SO + NATIJA
        I was tired, SO I went to bed.

  Ma'no BIR XIL, faqat tartib boshqacha.


VERGUL QOIDASI:
  BUT, SO, THEN oldidan → VERGUL qo'yiladi
  AND, BECAUSE, WHEN oldidan → odatda vergul YO'Q


EGA TUShIB QOLIShI:
  'AND' va 'THEN' bilan bog'langanda, ega BIR XIL bo'lsa
  ikkinchisida tushirib qoldirsa bo'ladi:
     He locked the door and (he) left the house.  ✓

  Lekin kitobdagi 'then' misolida ega SAQLANGAN:
     She parked the car, then SHE went inside.
  Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

points.en: We use linking words to join sentences.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA.
'to join' = birlashtirmoq.

points.en: He locked the door. He left the house. → He locked the door and left the house.
points.uz: U eshikni qulfladi. U uydan chiqdi. → U eshikni qulfladi va uydan chiqdi.
points.noteUz:
AND — ketma-ketlik.
DIQQAT: ikkinchi 'he' TUShIB QOLDI (ega bir xil).
leave → LEFT (noto'g'ri fe'l).

points.en: Tom wanted to watch TV. I didn't. → Tom wanted to watch TV, but I didn't.
points.uz: Tom televizor ko'rmoqchi edi. Men esa yo'q. → Tom televizor ko'rmoqchi edi, lekin men xohlamadim.
points.noteUz:
BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIK.
Oldidan VERGUL.
'I didn't' = I didn't want to watch TV (qisqartirilgan).

points.en: Julie was happy. She didn't have any homework. → Julie was happy because she didn't have any homework.
points.uz: Juli xursand edi. Uning uy vazifasi yo'q edi. → Juli xursand edi, chunki uy vazifasi yo'q edi.
points.noteUz:
BECAUSE — SABAB.
Tartib: NATIJA + because + SABAB.
'didn't have ANY homework' — inkorda 'any'.

points.en: I was very tired. I decided to go to bed. → I was very tired, so I decided to go to bed.
points.uz: Men juda charchagan edim. Yotishga qaror qildim. → Juda charchagan edim, shuning uchun yotishga qaror qildim.
points.noteUz:
SO — NATIJA.
Tartib: SABAB + so + NATIJA — 'because' ning TESKARISI.
'go to bed' — artikl YO'Q.

points.en: She parked the car. She went inside. → She parked the car, then she went inside.
points.uz: U mashinani qo'ydi. Ichkariga kirdi. → U mashinani qo'ydi, so'ng ichkariga kirdi.
points.noteUz:
THEN — KETMA-KETLIK.
Oldidan VERGUL.
Bu misolda ega ('she') SAQLANGAN —
lekin tushirsa ham bo'ladi.

points.en: He was at work. He heard the news. → He was at work when he heard the news.
points.uz: U ishda edi. Xabarni eshitdi. → U ishda edi, o'shanda xabarni eshitdi.
points.noteUz:
WHEN — VAQT.
Davom etayotgan holat + TO'SATDAN bo'lgan voqea.
'at work' — artikl YO'Q.

exercises.instructionEn: Prepositions of Movement — look at the pictures.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N RASM VA O'N PREDLOG:

  PAST     — pochta qutisi YONIDAN o'tib
  TOWARDS  — ayol TOMON borish
  ACROSS   — ko'chani KESIB o'tish
  ALONG    — ko'cha BO'YLAB yurish
  UP       — zinadan YUQORIGA
  DOWN     — zinadan PASTGA
  UNDER    — ko'prik OSTIDAN
  INTO     — eshikdan IChKARIGA
  OVER     — to'siq USTIDAN sakrab
  THROUGH  — tunnel IChIDAN


ENG KO'P ADAShTIRILADIGAN JUFTLIKLAR:

  ALONG ↔ ACROSS
     ALONG  — UZUNASIGA (ko'cha bo'ylab yurish)
     ACROSS — KO'NDALANG (ko'chani kesib o'tish)
     Rasmlarda aniq ko'rinadi: 'across' da odam
     ZEBRA yo'lakda ko'chani kesib o'tyapti,
     'along' da esa piyodalar yo'lida yurib ketyapti.

  THROUGH ↔ ACROSS
     THROUGH — biror narsaning IChIDAN
               (tunnel, o'rmon — tepasi yopiq)
     ACROSS  — biror narsaning USTIDAN, yuzasi bo'ylab
               (ko'cha, dala — tepasi ochiq)

  OVER ↔ UNDER
     OVER  — USTIDAN (tegmasdan sakrab)
     UNDER — OSTIDAN

  UP ↔ DOWN
     UP   — yuqoriga
     DOWN — pastga

  INTO ↔ OUT OF
     INTO   — ichkariga
     OUT OF — tashqariga
     (kitobda faqat 'into' berilgan)

  TO ↔ TOWARDS
     TO      — yetib borish (maqsad)
     TOWARDS — ...TOMON (yo'nalish)


DIQQAT — 'PAST' IKKI XIL SO'Z:
  'past' PREDLOG = yonidan o'tib
     He walked PAST the postbox.
  'the past' OT = o'tmish
     'the past simple' = oddiy o'tgan zamon (10-unit)


ESLATMA:
  Coursebook 78-betda ham shu predloglar bor edi
  (Ralf ot minadigan hikoyada).

points.noteUz:
Rasm: odam qizil pochta qutisi yonidan o'tyapti.
'walk PAST the shop' = do'kon yonidan o'tmoq.
To'xtamaydi, faqat yonidan o'tadi.

Rasm: erkak ayol tomon boryapti.
YO'NALIShNI bildiradi — yetib borish shart emas.
'run TOWARDS the jeep' — Coursebook 77-betda.

Rasm: odam zebra yo'lakda ko'chani kesib o'tyapti.
KO'NDALANG harakat.
'across the road' = ko'chaning narigi tomoniga.

Rasm: odam piyodalar yo'lida yurib ketyapti.
UZUNASIGA harakat.
'along' — 'across' ning aksi (yo'nalish jihatdan).

Rasm: odam qizil gilamli zinadan yuqoriga chiqyapti.
'go UP the stairs' = zinadan chiqmoq.
Aksi: down.

Rasm: odam zinadan pastga tushyapti.
'go DOWN the stairs' = zinadan tushmoq.
Aksi: up.

Rasm: odam g'ishtli ko'prik ostidan o'tyapti.
Aksi: over.

Rasm: odam 'ENTRANCE' yozuvli qizil eshikdan
ichkariga kiryapti.
'an entrance' = kirish joyi.
Aksi: out of.

Rasm: odam to'siq ustidan sakrab o'tyapti.
'jump OVER a fence' = panjara ustidan sakramoq.
Aksi: under.

Rasm: poyezd tog' tunneli ichidan o'tyapti.
YOPIQ yoki QALIN narsa ichidan.
'through a tunnel / a forest / a crowd'.

wordFormation.introUz: 48-bet — sifat va ravish, bog'lovchilar, harakat predloglari.

groups.explanationUz: O'zbek tilidan farq qiladigan muhim nuqta.
-ly qo'shilsa ma'no o'zgaradi yoki umuman ravish emas.

groups.ruleUz: Sifatlar tartibi (bir nechta sifat birga kelsa)
groups.explanationUz: Ingliz tilida sifatlarning aniq tartibi bor.

patterns.formula: Look at THIS + sifat + ot.   ↔   Look at THESE + sifat + otlar.
patterns.exampleEn: Look at this tall tree. Look at these tall trees.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu baland daraxtga qarang. Bu baland daraxtlarga qarang.
patterns.explanationUz: SIFAT o'zgarmaydi ('tall'), faqat OLMOSh va OT o'zgaradi.

RAVISH fe'lni aniqlaydi.
SIFAT: 'He is a CAREFUL driver.'

patterns.exampleEn: He locked the door and left the house.
patterns.exampleUz: U eshikni qulfladi va uydan chiqdi.
patterns.explanationUz: Ega BIR XIL bo'lsa, ikkinchisida tushirib qoldiriladi.

patterns.formula: NATIJA + BECAUSE + SABAB.   ↔   SABAB + , SO + NATIJA.
patterns.exampleEn: Julie was happy because she didn't have any homework. I was very tired, so I decided to go to bed.
patterns.exampleUz: Juli xursand edi, chunki uy vazifasi yo'q edi. Juda charchagan edim, shuning uchun yotishga qaror qildim.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ma'no bir xil, TARTIB teskari.
'so' oldidan VERGUL, 'because' oldidan yo'q.

patterns.formula: Ega + WAS/WERE + holat + WHEN + to'satdan bo'lgan voqea.
patterns.exampleEn: He was at work when he heard the news.
patterns.exampleUz: U ishda edi, o'shanda xabarni eshitdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'when' — davom etayotgan holat va to'satdan bo'lgan
voqeani bog'laydi.

patterns.formula: Ega + fe'l + PAST / TOWARDS / ACROSS / ALONG / UP / DOWN / UNDER / INTO / OVER / THROUGH + joy.
patterns.exampleEn: He walked past the postbox. He jumped over the wall. The train went through the tunnel.
patterns.exampleUz: U pochta qutisi yonidan o'tdi. U devor ustidan sakradi. Poyezd tunnel ichidan o'tdi.
